 Meenakshi Sengupta Fri, October 30, 2026 at 7:06 PM UTC 2 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Photo by Gilbert Flores/WWD via Getty Images Olivia Jade has reportedly found love again after her breakup with Jacob Elordi, but her new romance does not involve tennis star Taylor Fritz . The YouTube star was recently spotted spending time with Australian art dealer and entrepreneur PC Valmorbida.
 Olivia Jade sparks dating rumors with art dealer PC Valmorbida amid Taylor Fritz speculation
 Photos shared by DeuxMoi showed PC Valmorbida keeping his arm around Olivia's shoulders as they enjoyed a stroll together. The pair stepped out in Soho on October 25. Olivia kept her look casual, wearing an oversized fleece jacket over a loose T-shirt, shorts, and flip-flops. Valmorbida, meanwhile, opted for a white T-shirt, blue jeans, and sneakers. They both wore dark sunglasses.
 Despite the apparent closeness between the two, Olivia and PC have yet to confirm the status of their relationship. Olivia, the youngest daughter of Full House star Lori Loughlin and her ex-husband, Mossimo Giannulli, reportedly ended her on-and-off romance with Elordi in August 2025. She was linked to Taylor Fritz post that.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement However, Olivia made it clear in a May interview with Bustle that she has no intention of discussing her dating life publicly. She said, "I will never speak on it, ever. That part of my life, I'm a completely closed book. I'm just going to be a mystery."
 "When I was younger, I wanted to say my piece a lot more. Now I don't have that desire at all. I can vent to somebody in my private life about it. It's just a feeling like, 'Oh, I don't really want to share that. That doesn't really benefit anyone. That doesn't really benefit me,'" she added.
 Before being linked to Olivia, PC was reportedly romantically connected to a few other high-profile personalities. These included fashion designer Mary-Kate Olsen, whom he was first linked to in 2007. The pair reportedly rekindled their connection in 2023. He was also linked to Theodora Richards, the daughter of Keith Richards.
